item.title: Haramasekai The Movie ~Mainichi ga Kozukuri Youbi~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Anime-seal
  • 発売日: 2011-07-15
  • スコア: 6.15/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 孕ま世界 The movie ～毎日が子作り曜日～
  • 英語名: Haramasekai The Movie Mainichi ga Kozukuri Youbi

あらすじ

My name is Yamato. I am a rare person.

That is to say, I am one of the 0.01% of the population that is “male”.

What happened, you ask? The curse of god or the work of devils, nobody knows. But the whole world’s male birth rate took a nosedive.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Anime-seal
  • 発売日: 2010-08-06
  • スコア: 5.33/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 全自動強制中出しルームへようこそ！ ―相良家三姉妹の楽しいセックスライフ―
  • 英語名: Zenjidou Kyousei Nakadashi Room e Youkoso! -Sagarake Sanshimai no Tanoshii Sexlife-

あらすじ

A full automatic animation about the sex of three sisters.

Kanade, Aisu and Miki were all in love with Kanade’s private teacher.

Their idea of how to get him was a bit radical: the sexual relationship with him with the help from the automatic sex support machine advertised on TV should be the way!
